selection.rule: Post-hoc selection of the three most content-divergent pairs after excluding semantic near-duplicate queries from the 25 rank-1 failures.
selection.representative_answer: The displayed text is the stored on-policy generation with seed 43. Retrieval uses the mean of five answer vectors, not this draw alone.
